title: Remove a shell alias
summary: Delete an alias from your current shell session. The alias will no longer work until you redefine it or restart your shell if it was saved in a config file.

steps.explain: Use the unalias command followed by the alias name to remove it.

placeholders.name: WORD
placeholders.description: The name of the alias to remove

steps.expect: No output is displayed if the alias is removed successfully.
